INSERT INTO HOSPITAL_DELETE_HISTORY( DELETE_HISTORY_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, HOSPITAL_NAME, OWNER_ID, OWNER_NAME, CLOSE_REQUEST_ID, DELETE_REASON, CLOSED_AT, DELETED_AT, DELETED_BY ) SELECT SEQ_HOSPITAL_DELETE_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, H.HOSPITAL_ID, H.NAME, H.OWNER_ID, NVL(M.NICKNAME, NVL(H.OWNER_NAME,'병원장 미등록')),
CLOSE_REQUEST.REQUEST_ID, CLOSE_REQUEST.REQUEST_REASON, CLOSE_REQUEST.PROCESSED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{deletedBy} FROM HOSPITAL H LEFT JOIN APP_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = H.OWNER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REQUEST_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, REQUEST_REASON, PROCESSED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY HOSPITAL_ID ORDER BY PROCESSED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, REQUEST_ID DESC) AS RN FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_TYPE = 'CLOSE' AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) CLOSE_REQUEST ON CLOSE_REQUEST.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND CLOSE_REQUEST.RN = 1 WHERE H.HOSPITAL_ID = #{hospitalId} AND H.STATUS = 'CLOSED'
mapper.select: SELECT HUR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, HUR.HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, HUR.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, HUR.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, HUR.STATUS AS requestStatus, HUR.APPLICANT_NAME AS applicantName, NVL( M.NICKNAME, NVL(H.OWNER_NAME, '병원장 미등록')) AS ownerName, M.EMAIL AS ownerEmail, HUR.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS businessNumber, HUR.DOCUMENT_URL AS documentUrl, HUR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, HUR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, HUR.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, HUR.PROCESSED_AT AS processedAt, HUR.PROCESSED_BY AS processedBy, H.STATUS AS currentHospitalStatus, H.NAME AS currentHospitalName, H.PHONE AS currentHospitalPhone, H.ADDRESS AS currentHospitalAddress, H.DETAIL_ADDRESS AS currentHospitalDetailAddress, H.DISTRICT AS currentHospitalDistrict, H.WEBSITE_URL AS currentHospitalWebsiteUrl, H.LATITUDE AS currentHospitalLatitude, H.LONGITUDE AS currentHospitalLongitude, H.OPEN_TIME AS currentHospitalOpenTime, H.CLOSE_TIME AS currentHospitalCloseTime, H.BREAK_TIME AS currentHospitalBreakTime, H.CLOSED_DAYS AS currentHospitalClosedDays, H.DOCTOR_INFO AS currentHospitalDoctorInfo, H.DESCRIPTION AS currentHospitalDescription, H.IMAGE_URL AS currentHospitalImageUrl, H.NOTE AS currentHospitalNote, HUR.HOSPITAL_NAME AS requestedHospitalName, HUR.HOSPITAL_PHONE AS requestedHospitalPhone, HUR.HOSPITAL_ADDRESS AS requestedHospitalAddress, HUR.HOSPITAL_DETAIL_ADDRESS AS requestedHospitalDetailAddress, HUR.HOSPITAL_DISTRICT AS requestedHospitalDistrict, HUR.HOSPITAL_WEBSITE_URL AS requestedHospitalWebsiteUrl, HUR.HOSPITAL_LATITUDE AS requestedHospitalLatitude, HUR.HOSPITAL_LONGITUDE AS requestedHospitalLongitude, HUR.OPEN_TIME AS requestedHospitalOpenTime, HUR.CLOSE_TIME AS requestedHospitalCloseTime, HUR.BREAK_TIME AS requestedHospitalBreakTime, HUR.CLOSED_DAYS AS requestedHospitalClosedDays, HUR.HOSPITAL_DOCTOR_INFO AS requestedHospitalDoctorInfo, HUR.HOSPITAL_DESCRIPTION AS requestedHospitalDescription, HUR.HOSPITAL_IMAGE_URL AS requestedHospitalImageUrl, HUR.HOSPITAL_NOTE AS requestedHospitalNote, HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_START_AT AS tempCloseStartAt, HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_END_AT AS tempCloseEndAt FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR JOIN HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = HUR.HOSPITAL_ID LEFT JOIN APP_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = H.OWNER_ID WHERE HUR.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
SELECT AT.ANIMAL_NAME FROM HOSPITAL_ANIMAL HA JOIN ANIMAL_TYPE AT ON AT.ANIMAL_ID = HA.ANIMAL_ID WHERE HA.HOSPITAL_ID = #{hospitalId} ORDER BY AT.ANIMAL_ID
SELECT AT.ANIMAL_NAME FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST_ANIMAL HURA JOIN ANIMAL_TYPE AT ON AT.ANIMAL_ID = HURA.ANIMAL_ID WHERE HURA.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY AT.ANIMAL_ID

SELECT H.HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, H.NAME AS hospitalName, H.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, NVL( M.NICKNAME, NVL(H.OWNER_NAME, '병원장 미등록')) AS ownerName,
M.EMAIL AS ownerEmail, CLOSE_REQUEST.REQUEST_ID AS closeRequestId, CLOSE_REQUEST.REQUEST_REASON AS closeReason, CLOSE_REQUEST.PROCESSED_AT AS closedAt FROM HOSPITAL H LEFT JOIN APP_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = H.OWNER_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT REQUEST_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, REQUEST_REASON, PROCESSED_AT, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY HOSPITAL_ID ORDER BY PROCESSED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, REQUEST_ID DESC) AS RN FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_TYPE = 'CLOSE' AND STATUS='APPROVED') CLOSE_REQUEST ON CLOSE_REQUEST.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND CLOSE_REQUEST.RN = 1 WHERE H.STATUS='CLOSED' ORDER BY CLOSE_REQUEST.PROCESSED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, H.HOSPITAL_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT (*) FROM HOSPITAL WHERE STATUS = 'CLOSED'

SELECT H.HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, H.NAME AS hospitalName, NVL(M.NICKNAME,NVL(H.OWNER_NAME, '병원장 미등록'))AS ownerName, M.EMAIL AS ownerEmail, H.STATUS AS hospitalStatus, HUR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, HUR.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, HUR.STATUS AS requestStatus FROM HOSPITAL H LEFT JOIN APP_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = H.OWNER_ID LEFT JOIN HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR ON HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.STATUS = 'PENDING'
AND H.STATUS != 'CLOSED'
AND (UPPER(H.NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(M.NICKNAME, NVL(H.OWNER_NAME, '') ) ) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL_ANIMAL HA WHERE HA.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HA.ANIMAL_ID = #{animalType} )
AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = #{requestType}
ORDER BY
H.NAME
NVL( M.NICKNAME, NVL(H.OWNER_NAME, '병원장 미등록'))
CASE H.STATUS WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TEMP_CLOSED' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
CASE HUR.REQUEST_TYPE WHEN 'UPDATE' THEN 1 WHEN 'TEMP_CLOSE' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLOSE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
H.HOSPITAL_ID
DESC
ASC
, H.HOSPITAL_ID ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT OWNER_ID FROM HOSPITAL WHERE HOSPITAL_ID = #{hospitalId}
mapper.update: UPDATE APP_MEMBER SET ROLE = 'USER', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{ownerId} AND ROLE = 'OWNER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL WHERE OWNER_ID = #{ownerId} )
